articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.snippet: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
articles.snippet: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

articles.title: People Are Vibe Coding the Ads Out of Their Smart TVs: Here's How
articles.snippet: A viral Claude Code prompt lets Android TV owners switch off sponsored rows and tracking software and build their own home screens, with no root access and every change reversible.
